# Aurora Tidal Observatory Overview

The Aurora Tidal Observatory is a fictional research station used as the
deterministic acceptance corpus for Ragweld end-to-end verification. Every
fact in this corpus is invented, stable, and unique enough to verify in
retrieval results and citations.

The observatory monitors tidal dynamics in the Meridian Strait. It was
commissioned in 2011 and operates year-round with a staff of nine marine
technicians.

All telemetry collected by the observatory is stored in KestrelDB, the
station's on-premise time-series datastore. KestrelDB retains raw buoy
telemetry for 400 days before archival.
